newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak c.bank repo average yield rises to 18.38pct.
newsitem.headline: Slovak c.bank repo average yield rises to 18.38pct.

text.p: Average yield in a Slovak central bank (NBS) one-week repo tender on Tuesday rose to 18.32 percent from 18.02 percent in a similar repo on Monday, the NBS said in a statement.
The NBS offered 2.0 billion crowns and bids totalled 7.349 billion crowns. The minimum accepted rate was 18.10 percent, while the maximum rate was 19.00 percent.
The NBS added 2.0 billion crowns to the interbank market through a one-week repo tender on Monday with the average rate rising to 18.02 percent from 15.55 percent in a similar repo last Wednesday.
The central bank monitors market liquidity daily and decides each morning whether to hold any open market operations.

According to NBS figures, the Slovak banking sector as of August 4 exceeded the volume of minimum reserves requirements by 0.12 percent. The daily volume of minimum reserves for commercial banks totals 36.817 billion crowns in the current reserves period ending August 15.
